scientific_integrity: General statement proved by invariant Jacobi reduction, rank-one variational inequalities, monic-integral eigenvalue argument, and parity. Finite symbolic/full-graph checks are supporting evidence, not a substitute for the proof.
scientific_limitations: Unit-weight adjacency walk and shared-hub initial state only; no remote-corner or approximate-return classification; independent validation and priority audit have not been performed.
title: A sharp hub-revival cutoff for two hypercubes sharing one vertex
